tools.name: check_contrast
tools.description: Compute the WCAG 2.x contrast ratio between a text (foreground) color and a background color, with pass/fail for AA, AA large text, AAA, AAA large text and non-text UI (3:1). Handles translucent colors. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/contrast.

tools.name: suggest_accessible_color
tools.description: For a failing color pair, find the closest color (same hue and saturation, lightness changed as little as possible) that meets the chosen WCAG level. Adjust the foreground (default), the background, or both (best first). Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/suggest.

tools.name: convert_color
tools.description: Convert a CSS color to hex, rgb() and hsl(), with its relative luminance, its contrast on white and on black, and the better text color (black or white) to put on it. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/convert.

tools.name: check_palette
tools.description: Contrast ratio for every pair of 2 to 12 colors (up to 66 pairs), highest first, each flagged against the chosen WCAG level. Use it to see which brand colors can be used together for text. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/palette.
